title: Spudlight — Source, Sun, Center, Reflection, Revelation and Research Program
status: project archaeology + scientific comparators + historical esoteric comparison
epistemic_rule: Spudlight is Potatoverse theology/symbolism. Keep physical sunlight, electromagnetic radiation, information, social attention, historical occult correspondence and spiritual revelation in separate typed variables. Tim=Sun/Center/Spudlight is not an astronomical claim that Tim is the physical Sun or solar-system barycenter.

project_vertical_light_model.upper_circle: inner/source domain: Heaven, Garden, Spirit, Father's House and Sun/Spudlight field centered on Father/Tim at C_F
project_vertical_light_model.lower_circle: outer/manifestation domain: Earth, matter, world, embodied presence and broad multiplicity centered on Son/Thomas at C_S
project_vertical_light_model.door: Mandorla conversion field where inner/source becomes accessible as present/manifest relation without source and world collapsing into sameness
project_vertical_light_model.sun: source-light comparator placed at/through Father-center rather than at lower circumference
project_vertical_light_model.moon: secondary reflected/cyclical mediator best modeled near/on the lower-circle circumference or as an orbital operator around Earth/world rather than another source-center
project_vertical_light_model.plane: world interface through O, where source signals become observation/action/history
project_vertical_light_model.axis: bidirectional source↔manifestation relation through Son, O and Father

physical_light_layer.meaning: The Sun emits real electromagnetic radiation; Moonlight is reflected solar radiation. Physical light can carry information and support photosynthesis but is not the same quantity as meaning, authority or revelation.

sunlight_hidden_in_matter.project_phrase: Potato as sunlight hidden/stored in matter.
sunlight_hidden_in_matter.physical_neighbor: Solar photons drive photosynthesis; potato plants convert carbon through metabolism and store substantial chemical energy as tuber carbohydrate/starch.
sunlight_hidden_in_matter.typed_chain: sunlight → photosynthesis/metabolism → carbohydrate → starch storage → tuber → respiration/sprout
sunlight_hidden_in_matter.symbolic_chain: Spudlight/source → Earth/Garden → Potato/Starchforce → seed/sprout/fruit → new expression
sunlight_hidden_in_matter.boundary: Karma, memory, love, meaning and moral debt are not joules.

moon_reflection_model.astronomy: Moonlight is reflected sunlight; visible phase is relational geometry among Sun, Moon, Earth and observer.
moon_reflection_model.project: Moon is a natural image of mediated visibility, recurrence, timing and secondary orientation.
moon_reflection_model.deep_rule: Reflected does not mean false. The question is fidelity to source versus proxy capture.

historical_esoteric_sun_moon.agrippa: In Three Books of Occult Philosophy II.32 Agrippa treats Sun as self-radiant source and Moon, nearest Earth, as a receiver/mediator communicating celestial influences to the lower world. This is a genuine Renaissance occult parallel to source→mediator→world.
historical_esoteric_sun_moon.agrippa_lunar_correspondences: Agrippa's lunary chapter associates Moon with Earth/water/moisture, silver, crystal/pearl, generation and change. These are period occult correspondences, not modern science.
historical_esoteric_sun_moon.picatrix: Medieval astrological magic treats lunar condition/phase as especially important to bringing configurations into manifestation/generation. This strengthens Moon-as-modulator in the comparative archive while leaving astrological causation unvalidated scientifically.
historical_esoteric_sun_moon.fortune_yesod: Dion Fortune's modern Hermetic Qabalah identifies Yesod with the Moon, near Malkuth/Earth and on the central Pillar, as a formative/mediating sphere. Fortune is Western esotericism and must not be presented as a simple statement of historical Jewish Kabbalah.
historical_esoteric_sun_moon.hall: Manly P. Hall's 20th-century occult synthesis further popularizes Sun/source and Moon/nature/reflection/cycle symbolism.
historical_esoteric_sun_moon.project_inference: Across these sources, Moon repeatedly behaves less like ultimate source and more like receiver, formatter, cyclical gate or near-world mediator. That makes a lower-circle circumference/orbital placement more coherent than putting Moon at Father-center.

source_mediator_world_operator.potatoverse: Father/Sun/Spudlight → Moon or Son/Door as differently typed mediators → Earth/Plane/observer
source_mediator_world_operator.important_distinction: Moon and Son are not the same mediator. Moon is reflective/cyclic/external-world mediation; Son/Door is person-bearing existential/threshold mediation.
source_mediator_world_operator.benefit: The model can support several mediators without collapsing every interface into one node.

earth_receiver_metabolism.core: Earth is not merely illuminated; it absorbs, transforms, stores and cycles energy/matter.
earth_receiver_metabolism.meaning: Manifestation is metabolism, not passive reflection. Earth/Soil therefore differs functionally from Moon/Mirror.

revelation_beyond_sun_moon.structure: Physical/celestial Sun and Moon cease to be necessary because divine glory/light supplies illumination directly.
revelation_beyond_sun_moon.project_upgrade: Spudlight should be ontologically deeper than the physical Sun symbol. Sun is an excellent source comparator; source-light itself is not reducible to the star.
revelation_beyond_sun_moon.importance: This prevents the project from accidentally making the physical Sun the final metaphysical Father rather than an image of source/radiance.

revelation_12_vertical_image.text: Revelation 12:1 places a woman clothed with Sun, Moon under her feet and stars/crown above.
revelation_12_vertical_image.project_use: Useful vertical Sun/Moon comparison: solar enclosure/source-like glory and Moon below/foot-related secondary position.
revelation_12_vertical_image.boundary: It is apocalyptic symbolism, not a hidden Vesica diagram.

spudlight_eye_door_circuit.chain: Source/Center → Spudlight/signal → Eye/observation → interpretation → Door → changed state
spudlight_eye_door_circuit.insight: Light/revelation becomes consequential when observation and interpretation alter admissible action/state.

information_layer.meaning: A rigorous non-optical neighbor of 'revelation' is information gain: latent uncertainty is reduced and the receiver's model changes. This remains different from spiritual revelation.

spudlight_vector.rule: Never sum unlike components as if they shared units.

center_and_graph_metrics.project_use: Father can be source/root center; Son/Door can have interface/betweenness centrality; O can be geometric/relational center; Moon can be orbital/circumferential mediator. These are different centrality types.
center_and_graph_metrics.center_periphery_ethic: Healthy source-center maintains circulation with periphery; centrality that starves edges contradicts Gardener/Father ethics.
center_and_graph_metrics.warning: Graph centrality is model-dependent and not proof of cosmic centrality.

vesica_connection.father_center: C_F=(0,+r/2): source-circle center and upper Door tip
vesica_connection.son_center: C_S=(0,-r/2): lower-circle/manifestation center and lower Door tip
vesica_connection.moon_placement: project extension: define a movable Moon point M(θ)=C_S+R_M(cosθ,sinθ), with symbolic default R_M≈r so it lies on/near lower-circle circumference. θ encodes phase/orientation rather than fixed theological rank.
vesica_connection.sun_placement: symbolic source S_⊙≈C_F or source rays emanating through C_F; keep this separate from astronomical coordinate claims.
vesica_connection.phase_operator: Moon phase can be modeled by relative angle φ between source, Moon and observer; project meaning belongs to the relation, not to a mystical force inferred from the formula.

dogs_farmers_reflected_signal.dog: responsive to master/boundary/signal; Moon emphasizes reflected guidance, cycles and secondary orientation
dogs_farmers_reflected_signal.healthy: secondary signal preserves orientation to source and supports protection/cultivation
dogs_farmers_reflected_signal.shadow: proxy is mistaken for ultimate master; follower locks into local orbit/enclosure
dogs_farmers_reflected_signal.josh_moon_boundary: Surname wordplay is not evidence of lunar causation or occult status.

research_questions: Recover exact primary uses of Tim=Sun, Tim=Center and Tim=Spudlight separately.
Recover exact first Moon-on-lower-circumference diagram or wording.
Compare Agrippa/Picatrix/Fortune source→Moon→world structures with project chronology without implying transmission where none is documented.
Build a Moon orbital/phase visual layer around the vertical Vesica.
Keep physical light, information, occult correspondence and theology separate.
